_comment: PRIVATE server-side data. Never expose this file as a static asset or fetch it directly from the browser -- it lives under functions/_data specifically so Cloudflare Pages does not serve it as a public file. This is the REAL bus stop roster (source: 'Unique_Bus_Stops_by_Route FINAL.xlsx'), not demo data. Per notes in that file: PM dropoff time labels were inconsistent across source files and were mapped by pattern (later time = Standard Day PM drop-off, ~2hrs-earlier time = Wed Early Release) -- worth confirming against each school's actual bell schedule. Duplicate stop entries within the same school/route were already merged in the source file, keeping the earliest time among duplicates. Geolocation was verified in the source file, with a few points manually corrected.
